newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN says Q1 electricity, heat sales up.
newsitem.headline: EVN says Q1 electricity, heat sales up.

text.p: Austria's leading regional utility group EVN said on Thursday electricity sales in the first quarter of its 1996/97 business year rose 2.2 percent, while heat sales surged 15.4 percent in the same period.
In a statement after the group's annual general meeting, EVN said electricity sales stood at 1.446 gigawatt hours, and heat sales were at 121 gigawatt hours at the end of August.
Gas sales fell 6.6 percent to 343 cubic metres, partly because of a 2.9 percent drop in sales to local networks because of less severe winter temperatures, the company added.
EVN also said shareholders had approved the board's proposed 25 schilling dividend for 1995/96, up two schillings from the previous year.
EVN shares closed down 4.50 schillings at 1,544.0 in an otherwise flat Vienna market before the announcement. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
